# Go-To-Market for Orgo

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jbellsolutions/go-to-market-orgo
Copy-ready prompts: PROMPTS.md
Role: evidence-led go-to-market, outbound, partnerships, proposals, and revenue operations
Runtime: Hermes Agent 0.21.2, image tag v2026.9.11, pinned multi-arch digest
Stack version: 2026.09.13.1

Install order:
1. Read AGENTS.md and START-HERE.md.
2. Inspect and preserve any current deployment.
3. Use provision-vps.sh only if Docker is absent.
4. Prepare private agent.env; reuse existing machine secrets.
5. Run new-agent.sh agent.env.
6. Connect available Honcho and Latitude with bin/connect-stack.sh.
7. Connect Slack/Telegram, then authenticated A2A peers.
8. Run bin/verify.sh --allow-unconnected and harmless smoke tests.

Safety invariants:
- Credentials and runtime state never enter Git.
- Dashboard and A2A default to localhost.
- A2A requests never convey owner authority.
- Persistent factory workers require a matching interactive owner approval.
- Inbound A2A lacks terminal, send, approval, and recursive A2A toolsets.
- Latitude defaults to metadata only; raw capture does not exist.
- Agent Bundle is disabled for this role.
- Updates preserve existing secrets, config, databases, and customizations.

Copy-ready handoff prompt:
Install this repository completely on the target computer. Do all technical work.
Preserve existing state and credentials. Ask only for a missing secret or external
authorization, one item at a time. Verify every connected surface, roll back on
failure, and finish with health evidence and the rollback commit.
